summary: Completed requested Supplier Training verification with non-destructive live checks: frontend admin page assertions and backend focused regression + live authz/non-mutation tests for PATCH/DELETE training endpoints.

critical.issue: Completion threshold is not truly hardcoded server-side; endpoint still accepts client-provided completion_threshold (router passes form value into training_service.create_training).

integration_issues.issue: Not executed with a valid submission due to non-destructive test constraint (no live creates/deletes/disables). Code review confirms disabled/loading wiring (isCreating + disabled button), but runtime submission behavior remains to be revalidated in a safe test environment.

action_items: Enforce 100% completion threshold on backend create path (ignore/reject any client-supplied completion_threshold).
Optionally add one backend test asserting create-training response always stores completion_threshold=100.
Re-verify create button loading/disable behavior with a disposable test record in non-production-like environment where mutation is allowed.
critical_code_review_comments: router.py remains oversized (~1000 lines >700 guideline), increasing regression risk for supplier assessment changes.
Training hardcode requirement is only UI-level right now; API contract still permits non-100 thresholds via direct calls.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested non-destructive UI assertions passed; create-submit loading behavior not runtime-mutated)

seed_data_creation: None (this run intentionally avoided create/delete/disable mutations in live UI/API).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live admin training page verified: due-date input present, threshold input absent, heading/sidebar label shows Trainings, list copy shows '100% completion required' and 'X of Y suppliers complete', and per-training due-date/save/toggle/delete controls render. Backend authz checks passed for supplier + non-admin user against PATCH/DELETE training endpoints with post-check confirming no mutation of selected existing training record.
rca of the issue: Root cause for threshold hardcode gap: backend router still accepts completion_threshold form input and forwards it to training_service.create_training; thus any client bypassing UI can persist non-100 thresholds. Mitigation: remove form field from API contract or clamp/override to 100 server-side before persistence.
